statement: Malavya Yoga (Venus in its own or exaltation sign, in a kendra from the Ascendant) carries artistic sensibility, appreciation of beauty, and comfortable, harmonious circumstances — traditionally read as favoring the arts and relationships.
editorial_note: Reflects a widely-repeated interpretation found throughout standard Vedic astrological literature, exemplified by (not claimed as a verbatim quotation of) the cited source.
